about_the_game:
We have Gundam and Armored Core at home!

Yrdenwatch - Der Drache von Lidoriya, is a narrative-driven action mecha game. It is being developed by a German games studio called "Studio filthy Dragons".

  • Interactive fully 3D mecha action

  • 6 directions of movement

  • Cockpit and Third person mode

  • Loadout screen to customize the mech

  • Fully voiced dialogs

  • Multiple weapon types

  • 13 action packed missions

  • Epic mecha bossfights

  • An explorable baseship where the mech and its pilot are stationed

  • Interesting characters with their own perspectives and stories

War has changed

Since the invention of Caliboors in the world of Yrden, wars and conflicts have evolved. A Caliboor is a monster made of special steel, deadly intentions, and an experienced pilot. These machines can move at extreme speeds and thus reach their targets before everyone else.

Blink and you'll die

If you want to survive in this world, you need to learn how to pilot this machine. Think about what equipment to buy and what strategy you will use in battle. It's not a matter of the right equipment or the right mindset. This is a matter of skill, experience, and the will to dominate.

You can (Not) advance

This isn't a world for humans; this is a world for filthy beasts with sharp teeth and soldiers who mourn for their fallen comrades. So talk to your fellow crewmates, learn about their world, and take comfort in the fact that you have a family now.

Pretty lights

Your enemies will be fierce, they will be relentless, and you will be their next victim. Unless you disagree, in that case, slaughter them all, give in to your urge, become one with the machine, slice until breathing stops, fire until movement stops. There is a dragon inside of you; release it, oh mighty machine spirit!

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts serious topics such as war, hostages, gunviolence and abuse. It does not tip toe around these. Its honest and mature. Its not the intention to shock people, just to be realistic and immersive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770/AMD Radeon R9 280X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5/AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070/AMD RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: This game is about piloting a giant mech with wings that has multiple guns attached to it. It's explosive, fast-paced, skill-based, and full of gun violence. It's also a story-driven game where you explore a spaceship and talk to your fellow crew members!
